_note: Hand-checked cases for the IAS Calculator's engine (website/resources/IAS-Calculator.html), run by tools/ias_selftest.py. Each case is a setup (the page's defaults fill the rest) and the numbers the game's rules give, worked out by hand in 'why'. f0 = the first part's frames (attack 1, the skill, the sequence), swings = a repeating attack's swing lengths.
